description:
Overview

Computer Programming – Online Instructor - BYU-Pathway Worldwide role at The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Computer Programming – Online Instructor - BYU-Pathway Worldwide role at The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Job Description

Candidates must be fluent in English and submit their application in English to be considered.

Only those currently living in and authorized to work in Brazil are eligible. The application system will store candidate information. Once submitted, application details will be shared with Church Education System (CES) partners involved in the selection process. Applicants may receive a rejection email during or after review; however, unless a direct rejection is received from the hiring manager, applications will remain active and under consideration.

Responsibilities

  • The Computer Programming Course Instructor is an important part of the instructional team. With a strong focus on the academic success of every student, instructors use their subject matter expertise, deep understanding of the curriculum, and student population to:
  • Identify trends impeding academic success.
  • Conduct targeted outreach and provide instruction to target groups and individuals.
  • Build capable learners, confident in their ability to succeed academically and in life.
  • Instructors do not develop lessons or assessments, nor do they issue grades on student work (grading is handled by a centrally managed pool of qualified Graders).
  • Their focus is on the academic success of every student in their care.

Important: This is a part-time work-from-home position with the following flexible schedule:

  • 10-12 hours per week (may vary week-to-week)
  • At least 5 days worked each week
  • Required attendance at periodic team meetings (as established by the department)

Course Description

Teaching and mentoring students (using Python and C#) for:

  • CSE 110 - Introduction to Programming
  • CSE 111 - Programming with Functions
  • CSE 210 - Programming with Classes
  • CSE 212 - Programming with Data Structures

These courses provide students with foundational computer programming skills, enabling them to contribute to software development teams.

Position Summary

BYU Pathway and BYU Idaho online courses are structured to include both an instructor and graders. Instructors are responsible for teaching and overall course delivery, while graders support the learning process by reviewing and evaluating assignments and providing students with constructive feedback. We are seeking instructors who will apply their skills and subject matter expertise to mentor students and facilitate teaching/learning experiences.

Qualifications

NOTE : An applicant’s résumé and official transcripts will be used to determine eligibility to serve as an instructor for the Computer Programming courses. Please clearly highlight relevant education, professional work, and technologies on your résumé.

General Instructor Requirements

  • Deep understanding of and commitment to BYU Pathway Worldwide’s mission, defining characteristics, and student population.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (required).
  • Adaptability to new processes, procedures, and technologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills: professional, respectful, and unbiased in sensitive situations.
  • Proven reliability and ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, video conferencing, and discipline-specific software.
  • Experience with online teaching/learning, especially with at-risk learners (preferred).

Specific Course Requirements: Computer Programming

  • A master’s degree in computer science or a related field and two years of professional software development experience is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree and 3-5 years of work experience may be considered.
  • Experience with Python, C#, or Java is required.
  • Expert proficiency with basic programming concepts, such as variables, data types, collections, loops, functions, libraries, I/O, error handling, and testing.
  • Expert proficiency with basic object-oriented programming concepts, such as classes, methods, variables, and access modifiers.
  • Familiarity with data structures and algorithms.
  • Understanding object-oriented principles, such as abstraction, encapsulation, polymorphism, and inheritance.
  • Experience with version control software, such as GitHub.
  • Experience with code editors, such as Visual Studio Code.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing.

Additional Documentation Requirement

Candidates advancing to the next stage of the hiring process will be required to provide the following academic documents:

  • Official transcript (histórico escolar) of a completed bachelor’s or master’s degree. The transcript must be sent directly from the awarding institution, either in digital or physical format. Transcripts submitted by the candidate, regardless of format, will not be considered official for accreditation or academic credential verification purposes. This process may take time and may involve additional expenses, depending on the institution.
  • Copy of diploma (front and back) showing the date of degree completion or the date of the graduation/commencement ceremony (data da colação de grau).

Academic documents issued by Brazilian or international institutions are acceptable, provided they are officially recognized in Brazil and the country of origin (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional). Not applicable: in-progress transcripts and associate-level degrees. A completed bachelor’s degree is the minimum requirement for this position.

Documentação Adicional Requerida

Os Candidatos Que Avançarem Para a Próxima Etapa Do Processo Seletivo Deverão Apresentar Os Seguintes Documentos Acadêmicos

  • Histórico escolar oficial de bacharelado ou mestrado concluído.
  • O histórico deve ser enviado diretamente pela instituição de ensino responsável pela titulação, em formato digital ou físico.
  • Históricos enviados pelo próprio candidato, independentemente do formato, não serão considerados oficiais para fins de credenciamento ou verificação de títulos acadêmicos.
  • Observe que este processo pode demandar tempo e gerar custos adicionais.
  • Cópia do diploma (frente e verso) que comprove a data de conclusão do curso ou a data da colação de grau.

Serão aceitos documentos acadêmicos emitidos por instituições brasileiras ou estrangeiras, desde que reconhecidos oficialmente no Brasil e no país de origem (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional).

Não serão aceitos históricos de cursos em andamento e diplomas de nível tecnólogo. O requisito mínimo para esta vaga é um bacharelado concluído .

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst to our Marketing B2B team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Marketing Data Analyst is an embedded analyst position that plays a key role in transforming marketing data into dashboards and reports that drive strategic decisions across marketing initiatives. This role's primary responsibility is to support Insights Managers by preparing clean, accurate, and repeatable data assets and reports. The analyst will transform business questions and challenges into queries and dashboards, ensuring that the data product ecosystem is robust and consistent for others to consume. This key player shapes marketing strategy through targeted data products, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating across teams to enable data-driven insights.

About Ledn

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role & Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’ll balance help desk tickets and prioritize them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You’ll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and align them to the team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You know how to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs and integrate one system to another.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; able to explain ideas clearly and help users calmly.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others; you take security seriously and know what PGP is.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. Familiar with OSI model troubleshooting steps. Ability to self-manage and scope projects across multiple teams.

Nice to Have & Culture

  • Some familiarity with AWS; used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies Ledn values.
  • Builder’s mindset, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package, with equity and remote work options up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company.
  • Remote-first environment with global team.
  • Purpose-driven career and inclusive, diverse culture. Equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests can be made confidentially.

Other Information

  • Ledn is a global, remote-first company with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
  • As part of the selection process, candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.
  • No agencies or recruiters; we do not accept unsolicited resumes or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

  • Support AI-driven and automation-focused process improvements across finance and compliance.

Qualifications And Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or related field (MBA or CPA preferred).

  • Strong understanding of HIPAA, SOC2, and healthcare regulatory frameworks.
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online, Google Suite, Microsoft Suite, and spreadsheet modeling.
  • Experience with revenue cycle management, U.S. healthcare payer structures, and startup fundraising (SAFE notes, valuation, equity modeling, Series A/B/C terms).

  • Experience in M&A integration and investor relations.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role Details

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You'll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (not required to have certifications).
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to work efficiently.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, is excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company; through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the future.
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Additional Information

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. Our team is global and remote-first. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Data Specialist for Compliance - LATAM
description:
Join to apply for the Data Specialist for Compliance - LATAM role at dLocal

What’s the opportunity?

  • We're seeking a seasoned Data Specialist with a minimum of 5 years of experience to join our Compliance team, focusing on Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) transaction monitoring. You won't just be building models; you'll be a key voice in shaping our data strategy and processes, laying the groundwork for a scalable foundation that enables us to manage compliance data effectively across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by leading the charge on a critical business function

What will you be doing?

  • Lead the end-to-end data lifecycle for our AML/CFT and sanctions screening systems. This includes taking ownership of data, pulling from sources such as Amazon Athena and Looker, building and optimizing ETL processes, and ensuring data quality from the ground up. You will proactively engage with IT and data teams to secure the necessary support
  • Design, build, and deploy advanced machine learning models to detect and prevent financial crime, with a focus on minimizing false positives and identifying new typologies
  • Engineer robust features from transaction data, leveraging attributes like frequency, location, and amounts to enhance model accuracy
  • Implement and maintain real-time and batch monitoring systems to effectively analyze millions of transactions on a monthly basis
  • Engage with Compliance Leadership to stay ahead of evolving AML/CFT regulations and financial crime trends, ensuring our monitoring processes are always up-to-date and compliant
  • Generate comprehensive reports and dashboards for regulatory reporting and internal insights, communicating your findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

What skills do you need?

  • A Bachelor\'s or Master\'s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience as a Data Scientist, with a strong focus on AML/CFT transaction monitoring

description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance — combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Tech manager infosec seguranca da informacao
description:
Tech manager infosec seguranca da informacao

Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Gestão de Equipes de InfoSec: Liderar, motivar e desenvolver o time de segurança, garantindo excelência técnica e evolução de carreira;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Conformidade: Mapear riscos, acompanhar auditorias e manter os controles de segurança atualizados, mitigando vulnerabilidades em sistemas, processos e fornecedores;
  • Estratégia de Segurança: Definir e implementar a visão de InfoSec, alinhando práticas de segurança da informação aos objetivos de negócio e compliance (ISO 27001 e LGPD);
  • Resiliência Operacional: Estabelecer planos de resposta a incidentes, post mortems de falhas e priorização de soluções de longo prazo;
  • Arquitetura Segura: Apoiar times de engenharia e produto na definição de soluções resilientes e seguras, garantindo boas práticas em identidade, criptografia, monitoramento e resposta a incidentes;
  • Governança e Políticas: Estruturar e revisar normas, políticas e procedimentos de InfoSec, assegurando sua aplicação em toda a companhia;
  • Integração com o Negócio: Atuar junto a stakeholders internos e externos (clientes, parceiros e auditores) para demonstrar a maturidade do programa de segurança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência como Tech Manager, Security Lead ou correlata em empresas de tecnologia SaaS;
  • Conhecimento em ISO 27001, LGPD, gestão de riscos, auditorias e SoA;
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes técnicas, incluindo contratação, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e desligamentos;
  • Proficiência técnica em arquitetura de segurança de sistemas web e cloud (identidade, IAM, criptografia, monitoramento, incident response);
  • Experiência em traduzir requisitos regulatórios e de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Familiaridade com gestão de fornecedores de segurança e acompanhamento de contratos/SLAs.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Certificações de mercado: CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 LA/LI;
  • Experiência prática com DevSecOps e integração de segurança em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Atuação prévia em empresas SaaS da área fiscal/financeira;
  • Experiência em FinOps aplicado à segurança, com otimização de custos de ferramentas e licenças;

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 adiantados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Ledn collaborates with clients to democratize access to the global economy through its products and services.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be adaptable to the evolving corporate infrastructure landscape and motivated to contribute to a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing IT support and be the first line of support for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Proactively manage Mac endpoints and enterprise environments; procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding and offboarding experience.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and automation tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to IDP/SSO improvements (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Write clear help articles, automate repetitive tasks, and manage incidents to resolution.
  • Prioritize help desk tickets and participate in project work within agile sprints (Jira). Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools and onboarding processes (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows; knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Strong communication skills across all media; ability to convey ideas clearly and support others without frustration.
  • Excellent written communication for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Security-minded with knowledge of PGP and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); familiarity with OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and CLI workflows.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies company values.

Culture and Benefits

We seek leaders who are adaptable, resilient, and collaborative; a builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices; integrity and accountability in handling confidential information; and experience working in remote environments.

We offer a comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, including a competitive PTO package, stock ownership through equity, and remote-first policies allowing up to 180 days of remote work globally (subject to restrictions).

We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. Applicants may reach out for accommodation requests during the recruitment process; requests will be handled confidentially.

Location and Recruitment Notes

Location: Petrolina, Pernambuco, Brazil. We are a remote-first organization and may contact qualified applicants due to high volume. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; unsolicited agency resumes are not accepted.

Job description

A Fluency é uma EdTech que nasceu em 2017 com o sonho de mudar o mundo!

Com muita dedicação e o trabalho em equipe de pessoas extraordinárias, estamos empenhados em ampliar as fronteiras da educação, lançando novos desafios ao mercado e inovando no ensino online de idiomas! Estar na Fluency significa integrar uma comunidade de pessoas que buscam compartilhar ideias, conhecimentos e soluções entre times. Todos esses pontos contribuem no desenvolvimento da melhor experiência de aprendizado para alunos, professores, e nós mesmos.

Buscamos pessoas inovadoras, comprometidas, curiosas, apaixonadas por pessoas e pela educação para integrar a equipe.

O desafio:

Você será um dos pioneiros na estruturação de processos, governança e ferramentas de Analytics Engineering na Fluency, impactando milhares de alunos e empresas parceiras. Atuaremos em um ambiente descentralizado, onde times de BI, Ciência de Dados e Analytics estão espalhados em diferentes áreas, exigindo colaboração horizontal e protagonismo técnico.

Inscreva-se e conheça mais sobre o nosso time.

Main responsibilities

Construir a Fundação de Dados

  • Projetar e implementar modelos de dados escaláveis no BigQuery (GCP), garantindo integração com sistemas legados (AWS: Redshift, S3, Glue) durante a migração;
  • Criar pipelines de dados (ELT/ETL) com Fivetran, Dataflow e Airflow/Composer para consolidar fontes heterogêneas (dados proprietários e conexão com bases externas via APIs);
  • Definir padrões de qualidade, documentação e versionamento para tabelas bronze, silver e gold;

Governança & Autoatendimento

  • Estabelecer práticas de governança de dados em um ambiente descentralizado, garantindo que times de marketing, produtos, vendas, operações e outros tenham acesso seguro a métricas confiáveis;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas de autoatendimento (ex: modelos semantic layer no Dataform) para reduzir a dependência de queries complexas em áreas não técnicas;

Colaboração Horizontal

  • Apoiar o time de Data Analytics no fornecimento de dados curados para métricas de engajamento (ex: progresso de alunos em cursos de idiomas + tecnologia) e com time de Marketing/Sales para métricas de aquisição;
  • Trabalhar com times de Ciência de Dados para operacionalizar modelos de ML;
  • Integrar dados de múltiplas áreas, enriquecendo bases e garantindo consistência e qualidade dos dados;

Data-Driven Culture

  • Ser corresponsável pela governança dos dashboards, criando padrões e documentando processos para oficialização de visualizações, garantindo que os dados sejam procedentes de fontes confiáveis e sejam relevantes para o negócio (queremos evitar proliferação de dashboards de usos específicos);
  • Criar documentação clara e reutilizável para democratizar o acesso a dados críticos;

Otimização de Stack

  • Avaliar e implementar novas ferramentas (ex: Monte Carlo) para monitoramento e observabilidade;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento de custos dos processos de transformação de dados, buscando otimizar desempenho e custos.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência como Analytics Engineer, Engenheiro de Dados ou função similar, com atuação em ambientes de alto crescimento;
  • Domínio de SQL avançado e Python para transformação de dados;
  • Experiência com cloud platforms (AWS e GCP) e ferramentas modernas (BigQuery, Google Dataform, dbt, Airflow, Fivetran);
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (Kimball, Data Vault) e arquitetura de warehouses;
  • Capacidade de modelagem de dados, incluindo criação de diagramas de Entidade-Relacionamento e implementação de pipelines baseadas nestes diagramas;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos e definir processos do zero;

You’ll support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM, EMM, Jamf). Nice to Have: Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications; startup/remote environment experience.

Culture & Fit

Ledn seeks a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment, with a builder’s mindset, adaptability, empathy, integrity, and accountability. We value collaboration across functions and cultures and remote work experience.

Ledn provides growth opportunities and a comprehensive total rewards package starting from day one. Benefits include a competitive PTO package, remote work eligibility worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions), and equity ownership in the company. We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout the recruitment process, please contact the Ledn team via email. title: Data Product Manager
description:
Data Product Manager

Location: REMOTE

Annual Compensation: $110,000.00 - $140,000.00 (DOE)

The Data Product Manager leads the definition, development, and lifecycle management of high-quality, reusable data products that drive value across business domains and the enterprise. Serving as a strategic link between business and technical teams, this role ensures data products are discoverable, well-governed, and interoperable from ideation through retirement.

You will oversee the creation and stewardship of enterprise reference data, including hospitals, helipads, airports, air ambulance bases, customers, health insurance plans, and payors. The ideal candidate brings proven expertise in research, data management, and governance, along with exceptional organizational and communication skills.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Coordination (20%)

  • Lead the development and management of GMR’s reference data processes, including stewardship, versioning, and golden record creation, in alignment with data lake and analytics strategies.
  • Define data quality metrics, standards, and SLAs.
  • Address data duplication, inconsistency, and fragmentation; develop and enforce data governance policies and operating models.
  • Collaborate with IT and security to standardize data access controls and support metadata management tool implementation (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog).
  • Assess data maturity, identify gaps, and implement improvements to ensure trusted, accessible, and well-managed data products.

Reference Data Research & Maintenance (60%)

  • Build and maintain comprehensive reference data for hospitals, customer profiles, transportation providers, airports, and fuel depots to support downstream workflows such as customer experience personalization and automation of eligibility and authorization processes.
  • Conduct ongoing research to maintain a current database of all U.S. air ambulance bases, including key operational details.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures for data research, maintenance, and change management to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Leverage enterprise data hubs and services for data storage, cataloging, maintenance, and sharing across key applications.

Data Integration & Synchronization (10%)

  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including Ambulance Communications, Clinical Informatics, Revenue Cycle, and IT Data Teams—to synchronize reference data across critical systems.

Data Analysis & Reporting (10%)

  • Develop reports and visualizations for reference data, market analysis, and air/ground decision-making.
  • Analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

Qualifications

Education & Industry Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, Computer Science, Information Systems, GIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years in data management roles, including database administration, data governance, master data management, or enterprise data strategy
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational databases, and data warehouse technologies, with a strong ability to analyze and validate data quality and lineage
  • Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Domo)
  • Skilled in research, data collection, maintenance, and spatial analysis (GIS strongly preferred)
  • Background in healthcare, air and ground medical transport, or dispatch environments
  • Proven experience developing data products, managing master data, and working with metadata tools and data cataloging platforms
  • Proficient in maintaining reference databases and spreadsheets
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and governance tools (e.g., Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra) is a plus

Why Choose GMR?

Global Medical Response (GMR) and its family of solutions are dedicated to delivering compassionate, quality medical care, primarily in the areas of emergency and patient relocation services. Here you’ll embark on meaningful work that will make an impact on you and the customers we serve. This posting reflects the role and its requirements; no additional site-wide notices are included here.

EEO Statement

Global Medical Response and its family of companies are an Equal Opportunity Employer, which includes supporting veterans and providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with a disability.

Check out our careers site benefits page to learn more about our comprehensive benefit options, which include medical, vision, dental, 401k, disability, FSA, HSA, EAP, vacation and paid time off.

description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable, creative in problem solving, and able to work in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We predominantly work on macOS, and you will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding departing employees. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools. You will detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix incidents as needed. You will work on projects over sprints, and document your work in Jira. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn :

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of API integrations between systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear, friendly, and concise writing.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, macOS enterprise configuration, and technical onboarding/offboarding processes.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI model; ability to troubleshoot methodically.
  • Self-management with clear scoping of projects and priorities across multiple teams.

Nice to Have : Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit : You thrive in a startup/tech environment, value integrity and accountability, and can influence across functions with empathy and clarity. Experience working in a remote environment is a plus.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, competitive PTO, ownership in the company through equity, and remote work opportunities worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). We aim to remove barriers so you can love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing the Ledn team throughout all stages of the recruitment process; requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

Job Details

  • Seniority level : Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type : Full-time
  • Job function : Information Technology
  • Industries : Retail

Overview

Join to apply for the Software Engineer II role at Flex .

Flex is building a finance super app for premium business owners — reimagining every single aspect of the financial workflow and financial services for any entrepreneur. The company has grown revenue 25x+ since publicly launching in September 2023 and is on track to achieve profitability by late 2025. Flex is focused on mid-market businesses ($3 - $100M revenue) that are largely overlooked by existing fintech solutions and reliant on slow and outdated regional banks. We are targeting a :$1T revenue opportunity that is largely up for grabs.

Base pay range

$55,000.00/yr - $75,000.00/yr

Flex is a fully remote company and this role can be performed from anywhere.

About the Role

We\'re looking for a Software Engineer II to help build product features that power financial services. You\'ll work on systems that handle payments, credit, and other core products that our customers rely on daily to drive business operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full lifecycle of medium-sized features and tasks across our product stack
  • Build user-facing features, internal tools, APIs, and backend services
  • Write clear, maintainable, and tested code that you\'ll be responsible for long-term
  • Participate in code reviews and provide timely feedback to teammates
  • Build features with the end product and user in mind, not just the code
  • Reason carefully about how your work extends in service of larger product needs
  • Build upon systems and features that others depend on
  • Balance speed with reliability and compliance in a regulated environment
  • Collaborate with other engineers and product team members to deliver high-impact work

  • English proficiency
  • A strong work ethic

Technical environment

We primarily use Typescript, PostgreSQL, and GCP. We are building in a monorepo with a lean towards rapid value creation through trunk based development. Deploying to production 3-5 times a week is the average velocity of a team member.

What matters to us: We value ownership, product sense, and clear communication. You should be someone who thinks beyond just shipping code to understanding the impact on users and the business. We\'re a small team, so everyone wears multiple hats and jumps in where needed.

Why Join Us

Flex is growing quickly — you\'ll help shape the direction of a product and company with real momentum.

  • Provide medical information support via multiple venues including virtual presentations and medical meeting booth coverage.

Qualifications

  • Above average attention to detail, teamwork and initiative.
  • Ability to interact with other departments within the company and be proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and quickly able to learn new software.

  • Technical Aptitude - Understands complex technical topics.
  • Applied Learning - Engages in learning activities to maximize outcomes.

  • Languages: English and French – C1 or C2, Fluent or Professional Level.
  • Experience: Two to four years of related experience in scientific content creation within the pharmaceutical industry, medical education, and/or academia. Demonstrated expertise in drug information communication and management preferred. Drug Information or Clinical Residency preferred.
  • Computer Skills: Proficiency with Embase, Ovid, and content management systems preferred.

You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but focused on paid media. This role blends creativity with data-informed decision making and reports to the Director of Creative, leading Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance through a high volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.

  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon).
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with ownership of performance results.
  • Experience collaborating with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to present creative work clearly and professionally to internal teams and clients.
  • Ability to give constructive feedback to other designers and mentor their growth.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous campaign goals into visually engaging, conversion-focused concepts.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, asset handoff) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) for asset creation.
  • Bonus: experience designing high-performing ads for ecommerce, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We hire A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership and support each other relentlessly. We value autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Saiba mais sobre a Lemon

Sobre o Time De Tech

O time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares e somos responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis e eficientes que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The role is customer-facing, and you will be the first line of support for employees, via tools such as Slack and Jira.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Manager of IT who will wear multiple hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right candidate has demonstrated success in similar roles within rapidly growing, security-first environments and is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of Ledn\'s growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner looking for a supportive environment to grow IT skills. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing IT support to employees (via Slack, Jira, etc.); manage Mac-based enterprise environments.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding and offboarding experience for employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).

  • Manage incidents and respond to issues through to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects in sprints (Jira, agile methods).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tooling (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
