  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching), and OSI model steps.
  • Self-management skills to scope projects and coordinate across multiple teams; strong organizational skills.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace).
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment with a values-driven approach; remote work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package, starting on day one; comprehensive benefits and PTO.
  • Equity ownership in the company; opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven role in a global digital asset company; inclusive, diverse culture; accommodation support during recruitment.

Additional Information

  • Ledn operates as a remote-first company with a global team across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume applications, only qualified candidates will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; public social media review may be conducted. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Builder’s mindset; eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially with confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

  • Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (restrictions apply).

Application and Environment

Builder’s mindset · High agency · Strategic + hands-on balance · Cultural intelligence · Analytical clarity · Trustworthiness · Growth orientation

title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative - including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video - with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Location details : Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

Parental Leave : flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Endless opportunities for growth : Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Darkroom has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplaces, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. We accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s, and Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contributions in Marketing & Advertising.

About The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’ll dive into the pixels and provide tactical feedback on design and video, while threading together performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but focused on paid media. You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across formats including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities
  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.
Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities
  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display formats.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.
You should apply if this sounds like you:
  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram.

About This Opportunity

As a Finance Operations Analyst, you will have a broad set of duties related to driving operational efficiencies associated with customer and product pricing information within the InComm Financial Information Systems. You will apply strong understanding of prepaid business, a broad technical background, and exceptional communication skills to develop an atmosphere of cohesiveness and collaboration between all teams involved with the delivery of our services globally. This will include close work with both Domestic and International Retail Sales and Product Account Management teams, as well as the technical teams involved in pricing, billing, invoicing, settlement, and reconciliation services.

This role is required to study enterprise data stewardship across multiple channels and platforms. Areas of focus include reviewing and learning all project and business requirements while communicating across internal and functional groups to ensure on-time and in-spec project delivery of commitments made. The position has the responsibility of supporting the Analyst II position, assuring client/channel satisfaction to help drive improvements with pricing and billing invoices. This individual must be a self-starter, contributing to the development of solutions to market needs, challenge established views at all levels when needed to assure timely and accurate financial exchanges with our clients, and breaking down barriers, when necessary, to ensure customer needs are met. Professional level English communication skills are required.

This position is CLT and Fully Remote in Brazil. Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!

Responsibilities

  • Provide concise weekly status reports for all activities as assigned.
  • Promote idea generation and collaboration sessions with internal teams.
  • Follow process and protocols for data enrichment processes and technologies.
  • Communicate data requirements to counterparts and customers.
  • Communicate process changes to interfacing / cross-functional organizations.
  • Escalate data inconsistencies or issues in a timely manner to avoid creating a crisis mode.
  • Track and log issues to be addressed in retrospectives, suggest process improvements.
  • Effectively manage time, prioritize work, multi-task across many assignments.
  • Enforce workflows and business rules to improve the quality and delivery time for data enrichment
  • Enforce SLAs for Finance Data Administration tasks
  • Troubleshoot data related incidents
  • Research and document rules and requirements for the enforcement of secure protocols and data integrity
  • Other tasks and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

  • 1+ years’ experience in the Prepaid product industry, preferably with some experience in Finance, Accounting, or Data Management.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence people and drive decisions.
  • Foster teamwork by working cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals, resolve problems, and make decisions that enhance organizational effectiveness.
  • Solid technical background with ability to rapidly learn new product or platform capabilities and apply knowledge to efficient operational procedures / practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up one\'s sleeves to get the job done.
  • Skilled at working effectively in a fast-paced environment with cross functional teams in a matrix organization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence in presenting to C level executives.
  • Ability to explain complex, technical topics to non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in business, Information Technology, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or related fields highly desired

description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.   • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Builder’s mindset; eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

title: Finance Transformation Automation Associate
description:
Finance Transformation Automation Associate

Join to apply for the Finance Transformation Automation Associate role at dLocal

Overview

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets. By joining us you will be part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives.

What’s the opportunity?

  • We are seeking a Finance Transformation Automation Associate to drive the automation of financial and operational reconciliations. This role involves integrating data sources from banks and processors (APIs, SFTP, email), standardizing controls, and systematizing variance analysis to accelerate closes and reduce rework. The role blends financial–operational knowledge with skills in data ingestion services, and secure connectivity to move and validate data at scale. Success requires strong proficiency in Excel, familiarity with SQL and Python, and a strong focus on continuous improvement in an agile, fast-paced environment.

What will I be doing?

  • Integrate and maintain data sources from banks/processors via APIs, SFTP, and email workflows, ensuring data quality, completeness, and traceability
  • Execute and improve reconciliation controls for the different types of transactions supported by dashboards, matching rules, and audit evidence
  • Prepare and cleanse inputs (reconcilable groups, rules, sweeps), coordinating adjustments and new implementations with responsible teams
  • Analyze variances and differences across banks, processors, and internal records; conduct root-cause analysis and propose remedial actions and automation solutions
  • Develop analytical models (pivot tables, lookups; Power Query/Power Pivot, or equivalent) for KPIs, variance monitoring, and control tracking
  • Manage tickets and workflows in Jira for new reconciliations, rule/sweep changes, file uploads/removals, following strong documentation practices
  • Collaborate with Business Assurance, Operations, Treasury, Accounting, Product, and Data to resolve incidents, capture requirements, and coordinate UAT for new integrations
  • Standardize SOPs, strengthen controls, and scale end-to-end automations to reduce manual work, and rework during closes
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously in an agile context: gathering requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, performing UAT, and managing change

What skills do I need?

  • 2-4+ years in Finance Transformation, Treasury, Finance Operations, Engineering, or Process Automation, ideally within payments, fintech, or banking
  • Advanced Excel proficiency
  • Experience with SQL, Python and automation, with a track record of implementing tech-driven solutions
  • Experience with data ingestion and secure connectivity: APIs, SFTP, CSV/JSON; familiarity with VPN and SSH keys
  • Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI) is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, ability to context-switch across multiple projects
  • Growth mindset with high adaptability, comfort with change, and an agile way of working
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills
  • Fluent in spoken and written English

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe*
  • Flexibility: flexible schedules and performance-driven culture
  • Fintech industry: dynamic environment with opportunities to build and boost creativity
  • Referral bonus program: employees can refer candidates and earn rewards
  • Learning & development: Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: monthly budget to engage with your team
  • dLocal Houses: option to rent a house and work remotely with your team
  • Location note: for Montevideo-based roles, attendance requirement at the office is 55% (not applicable to IT and Fraud roles)

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you posted by email at every step of the process.

Additional information

For more about dLocal, check our webpage, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.

O dia a dia

  • Garantir a correta apuração, classificação e registro das operações contábeis, assegurando a conformidade com as normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC), internacionais (IFRS) e do manual de contabilidade do setor elétrico.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role will join Samsara’s Global Partnerships team, which is responsible for building and activating our ecosystem of go-to-market partners across Insurance, co-sell, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Public Sector routes to market, and Fleet Management Companies.

You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

This is a great role for somebody looking to make an impact and influence the future of our Public Sector partnership strategy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop key relationships and build scalable programs with our Public Sector distribution and resale partners to drive net new pipeline and accelerate sales outcomes
  • Work with Sales and other cross-functional partners within Samsara to identify opportunities that our partners can accelerate
  • Build a scaled Public Sector channel motion (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Play a role in shaping our Public Sector partnerships strategic roadmap
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5 years of experience in Public Sector partnerships or sales
  • Experience with scaled Public Sector channel motions (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Experience building programs with a history of driving the Public Sector pipeline through partners
  • Kind and collaborative orientation, who is energized by working with a lot of different types of people from many teams
  • A builder mentality—you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves; no task is too big or small
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in B2B technology or within a B2B technology ecosystem
  • Experience working with Carahsoft
  • Experience with common Public Sector contract vehicles used to purchase IT/cloud and/or fleet management solutions

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

4 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn\'s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit). You\'ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will

Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

LEDN is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. The company offers a suite of lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Ledn values integrity, progress, and empathy, and supports a remote-first, globally distributed team.

The opportunity is to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The role involves wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right candidate is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, with prior success in security-first, high-growth environments.

This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and serve as the first line of IT support (via Slack, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage technology equipment procurement, onboarding for new employees, and offboarding processes.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge base.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own improvements to IDP and SSO (Google Workspace, Okta) and assist in integrating systems via APIs.
  • Document solutions, write help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Respond to and resolve critical incidents; balance help desk tickets with project work in agile sprints (Jira).
  • Set objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned with team and company goals; work with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholders across the organization.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash/zsh/python and to use open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO (Okta) and working with APIs to connect systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and ability to craft tickets, emails, and Slack messages effectively.
  • Security-minded with understanding of PGP, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching), and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and prioritize work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management abilities; comfortable dealing with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
  • Nice to have: some experience with AWS; familiarity with GAM and command-line tools; certifications in Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace.

Benefits & Culture

  • Competitive total rewards package starting on day one, including ownership through equity.
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing up to 180 days of remote work per year (subject to restrictions).
  • Purpose-driven work in a company that values inclusivity and diversity.
  • Equal opportunity employer; accommodations available on request during all stages of recruitment.

Additional information

We are a remote-first team with a global presence across North America, Latin America, Europe, and Africa. Due to high application volume, qualifying candidates will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response. No agencies or recruiters, and no unsolicited resumes.

Why us, why now

The Compensation manager is responsible for the administration of AAMC’s Compensation Program. The Compensation manager plans, develops, and implements compensation initiatives, policies, and procedures that help the AAMC attract, engage, and retain high-quality employees and in turn achieve the organization's goals. This position is responsible for ensuring that AAMC’s compensation programs are consistently administered in compliance with internal policies and government regulations. How you will make an impact

Compensation Program Operations:

  • Partners with HR team members on recruitment and talent management activities

  • In partnership with HR Systems, manages annual merit process; Manages projects and workflow
  • Monitors the effectiveness of existing compensation practices and recommends changes that are cost-effective and consistent with compensation trends and AAMC objectives
  • Stays up to date on market pay trends and updates to salary surveys
  • Prepares annual merit and performance pay recommendations
  • Coordinates annual preparation of individual professionals goals for the leadership team
  • Prepares annual Executive incentive calculations and works with HR Systems team on payouts
  • Working with HR Systems team as needed, ensures classification & compensation components in Workday are up to date and accurate

Job Evaluation & Market Analysis:

  • Perform job analysis, job description review, position evaluation, grading, and pricing to ensure internal titling, leveling and mapping within the company is consistent and salaries are competitive
  • Reviews and maintains organization-wide job descriptions.

Policy and Procedure Development:

  • Designs creative solutions to specific compensation related programs and incentive plans
  • Create and update compensation policies and procedures to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements

Reporting and Analytics:

  • Prepares reports and analytics on compensation trends and metrics for management review
  • Prepares internal compensation reports for HR colleagues and management

Salary Data & Surveys:

  • Participates in salary surveys and monitors salary survey data to ensure AAMC’s compensation objectives are achieved

What you will bring to the role

  • Experience with position descriptions, job leveling and market pay matching.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience using Aon Radford, Mercer and Willis Towers Watson salary data and job levels Proficient with Workday

Certifications :

  • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) preferred
  • SHRM or HRCI certifications preferred
  • Advanced Level Microsoft Excel skills

Remote Work Eligibility

This position may be eligible for remote work.

$124,950.00-$147,000.00

The Senior Regulatory Writing Specialist is a professional responsible for the creation of regulatory materials for investigational and marketed products in alignment with regulatory and compliance practices. The individual will work directly with client teams to manage regulatory writing projects.

Degree: Advanced degree in a scientific discipline (eg, life sciences, pharmacy, medicine) or relevant work experience; or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Experience: At least 3 to 5 years as a Regulatory Medical Writer.

Fluent: English, C1 or C2.

Acts as a primary writer and/or project manager for key documents and projects.

  • Performs document-level QC (abbreviations, references to sources, data in text vs. data in tables/figures/graphs) and writer peer review (logical flow, sense check, etc.).
  • Leads project-level management activities, i.e., timeline preparation and oversight, and meeting scheduling. Guides less experienced writers on documents within their expertise.
  • Proactively contributes to improvements in medical writing processes.
  • Understands, complies with, and contributes to updates of SOPs, templates, best practices, policies, and regulatory writing style guides.
  • Develops project-level lexicons and conventions.

Position Qualifications

Above average attention to detail, teamwork and initiative. Ability to interact with other departments and be proficient in written and verbal communication.

Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, and able to quickly learn new software. Ability to apply regulatory guidelines to content development.

Education: Advanced degree in a scientific discipline (eg, life sciences, pharmacy, medicine) or relevant work experience; or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Experience: More than 2 years (typically 3–5 years) of experience in scientific/medical/regulatory writing in the pharmaceutical domain.

Computer Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Remote - Europe

Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include: Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs. Chart abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: Patient Navigator Lead
description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

Note: This is a field-based role requiring ~60% travel; proximity to a major US airport is essential (New York, NY; Boston, MA; San Diego, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Chicago, IL; Cleveland, OH; Minneapolis, MN; Atlanta, GA).

Primary Responsibilities

  • Direct Patient & Caregiver Engagement: Deliver 1:1 education (virtual and in-person) to patients, caregivers, and families on PDP, Nuplazid, and ACADIA Connect using approved materials; provide support ensuring patients and caregivers feel heard and connected; partner with advocacy groups, community organizations, and professional societies to expand reach; coordinate handoffs to Patient Access Managers for coverage and access support.
  • Team Leadership & Coaching: Mentor Patient Navigators, provide coaching and professional development, lead onboarding and training to ensure consistency in education and patient support delivery, monitor performance, and act as a primary escalation point for complex patient/caregiver situations.
  • Program Development & Execution: Lead planning and execution of patient and caregiver educational programs, workshops, and webinars; coordinate field-supported patient events and speaker programs; partner with Marketing, Advocacy, and Sales to identify opportunities for education and engagement initiatives.
  • Insights: Collaborate with Marketing to support patient and caregiver advisory boards; capture and synthesize insights to inform brand strategy and resource development; identify unmet educational needs and propose solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Field Sales, Patient Support Services, Marketing, and Advocacy to increase disease awareness and support earlier diagnosis; stay current on PDP, Nuplazid, and ACADIA patient services; represent the patient perspective in internal discussions; ensure activities comply with legal, regulatory, and company policies.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; healthcare or life sciences preferred. Advanced degree preferred.
  • 8–10 years in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry with a focus on patient support, education, or advocacy.
  • Prior experience leading or mentoring a field-based team strongly preferred.
  • Background in patient navigation, clinical care, pharmacy, or community health education highly valued.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills with a proven ability to develop others.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills; ability to translate complex science into patient-friendly language.
  • Compassionate, patient-focused mindset with ability to navigate sensitive conversations with empathy.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and demonstrates innovation in patient engagement.
  • Strong understanding of compliance and regulatory frameworks within pharma/biotech.
  • Field-based role requiring ~60% travel, with some evenings and weekends; proximity to a major airport is essential.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Patient-Centered Focus – Dedicated to improving patient and caregiver experiences.
  • Empathy & Emotional Intelligence – Skilled at providing compassionate support.
  • Collaboration & Teamwork – Works effectively across functions and with external partners.
  • Strong Communication – Clear and effective educator with patients, caregivers, and internal teams.
  • Adaptability & Initiative – Proactive in meeting evolving patient needs.
  • Privacy, Compliance & Confidentiality – Safeguards patient health information and adheres to company policies.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and manual handling. Occasional lifting up to 20 pounds. Travel required, including overnight and occasional after-hours work as needed. Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and near a major airport as needed. Ability to drive a company vehicle and travel by air.

Travel may be up to 75% of the time.

Salary Range: $112,000 — $140,000 USD. In addition to base salary, eligible for discretionary bonus and equity awards based on performance and location.

title: Field Reimbursement Specialist
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere.

Field Reimbursement Specialists (FRSs) are responsible for providing field support for patient access to client’s specified products through interaction with the client’s patient support program and provider customers.

FRSs provide their expertise and advanced skills to resolve complex patient access and provider reimbursement issues and to provide educational services across a variety of healthcare provider sites of care.

FRSs work directly with the provider and their office support staff and commonly interact with other reimbursement and patient support services provided by clients.

Play a vital role in helping patients gain access to life-changing therapies! From oral medications to biosimilars to critical cancer treatments, our associates, with their passion for patients, represent these therapies providing education, coverage, and access solutions to healthcare personnel.

FRSs will plan and engage with customers, leveraging client-approved resources, to educate on access and reimbursement topics relevant to assigned client’s product.

Our teams travel weekly, which could include overnight, to healthcare offices within a designated territory, using their knowledge of coverage, patient assistance, and health policy to educate office staff and break through access issues to ultimately help patients.

Typical Day:

  • Educate provider office staff and practice managers on logistics needed to support client product, including infrastructure needed to support in-office administration.
  • Educate provider office staff with understanding the payers’ coverage management strategies for product, including coding, billing, formulary, prior authorization, and appeal processes.
  • Probe to understand office processes and ability to discern root causes of access or reimbursement issues.
  • Deliver interactive educational presentations at various provider sites of service.
  • Provide information on relevant reimbursement topics related to our client’s products based on client’s approval.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to conduct field-based reimbursement and access support, education, and consultation to key account customers and cross-functional partners.
  • Understands the dynamics of Specialty Pharmacy vs. Specialty Distribution.
  • Broad understanding of the physician buy-and-bill model vs. assignment of benefits to alternate sites of care.
  • Experience in revenue cycle, buy and bill, formulary, benefit investigations, prior authorization, coding, and appeals processes.
  • Deep understanding of medical and pharmacy benefits/policies.
  • Live within a reasonable commuting distance of a major airport in the listed location and be able to travel within a territory that includes but may not be limited to MN, WI, IL.

Education and Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.
  • Bachelor's degree or specific Practice Management experience preferred.
  • Project management skills.
  • Experience with extensive travel.

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day.

title: Staff Accountant (Netsuite)
description:
Overview

INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role supports Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on NetSuite experience, and enjoys a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within NetSuite.

Location: Remote (EST work hours preferred). Remote work opportunity is offered as part of the role.

What we offer: professional development opportunities, a collaborative team environment, and participation in company initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • NetSuite Accounting Data Management: Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite; ensure completeness and accuracy of all entries across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll; conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues; support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.
  • Testing & System Validation: Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules; validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll; perform UAT during NetSuite updates or enhancements; work with Accounting, Finance, and IT to identify and troubleshoot system errors or configuration gaps; help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Month-End & Operational Support: Support the month-end close by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite; assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports; ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.
  • Documentation & Internal Support: Maintain accurate documentation of NetSuite processes, data input standards, and workflows; assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues; contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls; perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
  • Experience working with accounting data across modules like AR, AP, GL, and Payroll.
  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite ERP and accounting module navigation; understanding of US GAAP; excellent attention to detail; strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team; capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment; proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting data manipulation; effective communication and organizational skills.

What We Offer

  • Remote work opportunity.
  • Working hours 8-5 EST (preferred).
  • Monthly gross salary within the range of $1000-$2200.
  • Participation in our "One Window - One Tree" initiative.
  • Opportunity for professional development and growth.
  • A rapidly growing company with a collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Faça parte do CNPEM! No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades. A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal. Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Conduzir Testes de Controles e Substantivos: Desenvolver e executar programas de testes de auditoria para avaliar a integridade dos registros contábeis e a segurança dos sistemas de informação. Isso inclui a condução de testes de Controles Gerais de TI (ITGCs), a validação da conformidade das configurações e a análise de dados para identificar anomalias.
